topography.project_purpose: Canonical Bridge. Structurally: 71 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 5 ERC20 tokens, 1 Chainlink feed; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 9 functional families. Its contracts share 15 common project-authored base contract(s) (semver, ownableupgradeable, contextupgradeable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
